turns: 9; I wrote `e2e/api/generated/LIF-11.spec.ts` with one test, tagged `@LIF-11`. It passes against the running API, and `npx tsc --noEmit` reports no errors. No other file was changed.

The test signs in as `Member@Northwind.TEST` with the correct password and expects a 200. It then calls `/api/me` with the returned token and expects `email` to equal the seeded member address. The expected value comes from `USERS.member`, so the spec has no lowercase account-email literal for the PW-4 lint rule to flag. I didn't run `npm run lint`.
